stem.en: A population of insects is sprayed repeatedly with an insecticide, and after several generations most surviving insects carry a specific gene variant that breaks down the insecticide. What does natural selection actually explain about this outcome?
stem.et: Putukapopulatsiooni pihustatakse korduvalt insektitsiidiga, ning pärast mitut põlvkonda kannab enamik ellujäänud putukaid spetsiifilist geenivarianti, mis lagundab insektitsiidi. Mida looduslik valik selle tulemuse kohta tegelikult selgitab?

label.en: The gene variant for insecticide breakdown already existed in some individuals before spraying began (from random pre-existing variation), and those individuals survived and reproduced disproportionately, increasing the variant's frequency in the population over successive generations.
label.et: Insektitsiidi lagundamise geenivariant eksisteeris juba mõnedel isenditel enne pihustamise algust (juhuslikust olemasolevast varieeruvusest), ning need isendid jäid ellu ja paljunesid ebaproportsionaalselt, suurendades variandi sagedust populatsioonis järjestikuste põlvkondade vältel.

label.en: The insects needed to survive the insecticide, so their bodies generated the resistance gene variant in direct response to that need.
label.et: Putukad vajasid insektitsiidist ellujäämist, mistõttu nende kehad genereerisid resistentsuse geenivariandi otsese vastusena sellele vajadusele.

label.en: Individual insects that were repeatedly exposed to the insecticide gradually built up a tolerance during their own lifetimes and passed that acquired tolerance on to their offspring.
label.et: Üksikud putukad, kes korduvalt insektitsiidiga kokku puutusid, arendasid oma eluea jooksul järk-järgult taluvuse ja pärandasid selle omandatud taluvuse oma järglastele.

label.en: The surviving insects are transitioning into an entirely new, more advanced type of insect on their way toward becoming a different, superior species.
label.et: Ellujäänud putukad on üleminekul täiesti uude, arenenumasse putukatüüpi, teel muutumaks teistsuguseks, ülimuslikuks liigiks.
